findings.evidence: The assigned example ex-td-two-site-no-thermalization depends on post-nrqm-framework-autonomous-dynamics and def-nrqm-autonomous-dynamics-framework-evolution. Its Verification step 2.1 uses that external unitary-dynamics premise to establish state invariance; the A-page supplies the Gibbs weights, not the evolution law.

findings.location: Statement, recurrence paragraph beginning “For a region R on which a nonzero-time map T=φτ and all its iterates are defined.”
findings.evidence: The statement concludes recurrence for a finite-measure region but does not require that the region be invariant under T. Having all iterates defined does not make T a self-map of R; the recurrence result requires a measure-preserving self-map of an invariant measurable region. Add that invariance hypothesis or restrict the recurrence claim accordingly. The assigned consumer uses the volume-preservation result, not recurrence.
